name: backup-management-ux-hardening
title: Harden backup management UX and scope
description: Synchronize the backup page with the canonical manager restaurant scope, invalidate stale previews when restore inputs change, expose permission-aware controls, and compact the interface without changing snapshot semantics.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: BackupRun, snapshot schema, import/export service behavior, permission guards, audit logging, checksums, and conflict resolution semantics remain unchanged. The page now reuses useManagerRestaurantSelection, rejects stale restaurant data, invalidates changed restore previews, validates file/section inputs, and reflects backup.read/write/export/import. GitHub Actions run 29095427951 passed backend lint/tests/RBAC/build plus frontend conflict check/lint/unit/component/build/smoke. CI also exposed a stale English assertion in the current base review-insight test after its heuristic output was localized; the test assertion was aligned with the existing Vietnamese production summary without changing service behavior.
